Cabin Safety

كاشف الدخان

An electronic device installed in aircraft compartments, especially lavatories and cargo, to detect smoke and trigger an alarm for immediate crew action.

What is كاشف الدخان?

In this glossary, كاشف الدخان refers to: An electronic device installed in aircraft compartments, especially lavatories and cargo, to detect smoke and trigger an alarm for immediate crew action.

Definition

An electronic device installed in aircraft compartments, especially lavatories and cargo, to detect smoke and trigger an alarm for immediate crew action.

Operational example

The lavatory smoke detector has triggered; investigate and report status to the cockpit immediately.
